# PixelBoard v1.3.6

## What's New
PixelBoard v1.3.6 brings critical fixes for suggestion strip candidate rendering, emoji slot positioning, Morphe Manager bundle version metadata, and Advanced Settings stability:

* **Emoji Right Slot Placement**: Refined candidate slot index assignment (`candidate.l = i`). Primary word auto-completions now reliably occupy **Slot 1 (Center)**, while contextual emoji predictions are placed in **Slot 2 (Right)** without displacing word predictions.
* **Safe Haptic Feedback Hook**: Hardened haptic feedback invocation (`performHapticFeedback`) across devices and custom themes to prevent null pointer or context crashes.
* **Screen Rotation Grace Period for Rambler Voice Dictation**: Maintains continuous voice typing across device orientation changes by introducing a 1.5s grace period during display rotation, preventing sessions from abruptly aborting ([#146](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/146), PR [#165](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/pull/165) by Francisco Valentim Castilho).
* **Speech Diff Preservation for Voice Edits**: Retains speech diffs for voice replacements and mid-sentence voice commands (such as *"replace X with Y"*), word edits in respoken phrases, and mid-sentence cursor placements without overwriting surrounding compositions ([#167](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/167)).
* **Strict Language Enforcement & Anti-Drift**: Disabled proactive parallel ASR and seamless fallback in Rambler stock policy to prevent voice dictation from unintentionally switching languages or drifting to similar locales (e.g., Czech → Slovak) ([#154](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/154)).
* **Eliminate Text Duplication on Dictation Start**: Fixed an issue where starting dictation in an editor containing pre-existing text or recently pasted clipboard items would duplicate text at the cursor ([#166](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/166)).
* **Gboard 18.6.3 Native Split Readiness Gate Check**: Added native library readiness gate verification on split components for Gboard 18.6.3 (`Lsmi;`, `Locf;`), ensuring smooth and stable JNI initialization on fused and split APKs ([#168](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/168)).
* **AI Writing Tools Connectivity Fix**: Repaired request timeout and prompt template evaluation in `GboardAiWritingToolsRuntime`, eliminating *"cannot connect to server"* errors and restoring reliable Rephrase, Proofreading, and Tone adjustments via Google's Gboard server backend.
* **Direct Boot & Secure Storage Safety**: Added user unlock state checks (`UserManager.isUserUnlocked`) ensuring crash-free preference initialization during direct boot before initial unlock.

---

## Installation Instructions

### Option 1: Direct APK Installation (Recommended)
1. Download **PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk** directly to your Android device.
2. Open the downloaded APK from your browser or file manager.
3. Allow installation from unknown sources if prompted, and complete installation.
4. Enable PixelBoard in **Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard**.

### Option 2: ADB Sideload
```bash
adb install -r PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk
adb shell am force-stop com.akshaykadam.pixelboard
```

### Option 3: Patch via Morphe Manager
Add the custom patch source in Morphe Manager:
```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/main/patches-bundle.json
```
Select stock Gboard (v18.6.3.100 only) and apply patches.

---

| **Unsupported Versions** | Gboard 18.5 and older are **not supported** by this patch bundle |
| **Architecture** | `arm64-v8a` |
| **Android Version Support** | Android 12  through Android 17 |

# PixelBoard **Supercharged Gboard Mod featuring Google Pixel 11 series's Rambler Voice Typing & AI Writing Assistant [No Root].**

  

--- ## Overview **PixelBoard** is a sleek, ultra-clean enhancement of Google's flagship keyboard. Tailored for pure productivity, PixelBoard strips away unnecessary bloatware and focuses strictly on powerhouse capabilities: **Gemini Rambler Natural Voice Dictation**, **AI Writing Assistant**, **Modern Spell Checker Suggestion Chips & Grammar Checking**, **Scan Text Camera OCR**, **Screenshot Floating Suggestions**, **Material 3 Expressive Rounded Keys**, **Google Sans Flex Keycap Typography**, **Proactive Undo in Suggestion Strip**, **Emoji Palette V2**, **Super Insert Quick Hub**, **Restored Emoji Size Slider & Vibrant Emojis**, **Samsung & Vivo Clipboard History Sync**, and **Automatic Zero-Restart Instant Activation**. PixelBoard is engineered with an independent coexistence package ID (`com.akshaykadam.pixelboard`), allowing you to install and use it **side-by-side with your factory Gboard** without replacing, uninstalling, or risking system keyboard stability. --- ## Screenshots
--- ## Key Features - **Gemini "Rambler" Natural Voice Typing**: Speaks naturally by filtering out stutters and filler words (*"um"*, *"ah"*), auto-corrects self-corrections on the fly, auto-punctuates sentences, and includes an ergonomically minimizable voice toolbar. - **In-Line AI Writing Assistant**: One-tap proofreading, grammar fixes via interactive suggestion chips, and quick tone rewrite (*Professional*, *Casual*, *Concise*, *Emotive*) across every application. - **In-App Updater**: Built-in update checker directly inside Settings to check for new releases, view changelogs, and download & install the latest PixelBoard APKs seamlessly. - **Extended Clipboard Retention**: Customizable retention duration (1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or Never) with recent unpinned history expanded to 100 clips, floating screenshot chips, and reliable clipboard sync on Samsung One UI & Vivo. - **Modern Spell Checker & Grammar Chips**: Interactive clickable suggestion chips, grammar checks, and native red squiggly underlines on misspelled words across all apps. - **Scan Text (Camera OCR)**: Direct camera viewfinder tool in the toolbar to capture and extract text directly at your cursor from real-world documents. - **Material 3 Expressive Styling**: Pill-shaped rounded keycaps (Belka UI), Google Sans Flex variable typography, and restored vibrant emoji scaling with dedicated emoji tabs. - **Proactive Suggestion Strip Undo**: 1-tap Undo button right in the suggestion strip to instantly reverse unwanted autocorrections or accidental text deletions. - **Side-by-Side Coexistence**: Installs as an independent package (`com.akshaykadam.pixelboard`) alongside your stock keyboard with bypassed signature verification. > [!NOTE] > **Google Pixel Device Support**: Advanced on-device inference (**Private AICore / Astrea**) is available **only on Google Pixel devices**. Core **Rambler Natural Voice Typing**, **AI Writing Assistant**, proofreading, and tone rewrite work across all Android devices. --- ## How to Enable Rambler Voice Typing Follow these quick steps to activate Google's Gemini-powered **Rambler** natural voice typing: 1. **Open PixelBoard Settings**: - Tap the **Gear (`⚙️`)** icon in the keyboard suggestion strip, or go to Android **Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard > PixelBoard**. 2. **Select Rambler Dictation**: - Tap **Voice typing**. - Under **Dictation type**, choose **Rambler** (switch selection from *Standard* to *Rambler*). 3. **Instant Automatic Activation (No Restart Needed)**: - Your selection activates automatically in real-time — **no app restart or device reboot required**! - *(Optional)*: You can verify that **Enable Advanced Voice Typing** is toggled **ON** under **★ Advanced settings** (enabled by default). The toolbar **Restart (`↻`)** button remains available as an optional manual fallback if ever needed. > [!TIP] > Thanks to recent runtime enhancements, Rambler dictation initializes dynamically on the fly. You can immediately tap the microphone icon without needing to restart Gboard or kill the app process! 4. **Start Speaking Naturally**: - Tap any text box and hit the **Microphone** icon on PixelBoard. - You will see the **"Just speak naturally"** setup screen. - Tap **Get started** and speak freely — PixelBoard handles the cleanup automatically! --- ## Where to Find & Use AI Writing Tools Google's **AI Writing Tools** allow you to proofread, rephrase, and adjust the tone of any text on the fly. ### 1. Where to Configure - **In Advanced Settings**: - Open **★ Advanced settings** from the bottom of PixelBoard Settings. - Make sure **Enable AI Writing Tools** and **Support All Keyboards** are toggled **ON** (both ON by default). - **In Corrections & Suggestions**: - In PixelBoard Settings, go to **Corrections & suggestions > Writing tools**. - Ensure **Show writing tools icon in suggestion strip while typing** is enabled. ### 2. Where to Access While Typing - **Suggestion Strip (Quick Bar)**: - When typing in any text box across any app, the **Writing tools icon** (pen sparkle ✨) appears in the keyboard suggestion strip above your keys. - **Keyboard Tools Menu**: - If the icon is hidden, tap the **4-squares / arrow icon** on the left of the suggestion strip to open the tools drawer and tap **Writing tools**. - **Actions Available**: - **Proofread**: One-tap fix for grammar and spelling. - **Rewrite / Rephrase**: Adjust tone between *Professional*, *Casual*, *Concise*, and *Emotive*. --- ## ⚙️ Advanced Settings Screen PixelBoard features a clean, minimal preference screen modeled directly after the native Material You Gboard UI: - **Enable AI Writing Tools**: Force-shows the Writing tools icon in the suggestion strip across all apps and text views. - **Support All Keyboards**: Extends AI writing assistance beyond English to all keyboard layouts. - **Inference Backend Type**: On supported hardware, select between `GBOARD_SERVER`, `PRIVATE_INFERENCE_AICORE`, and `PRIVATE_INFERENCE_ASTREA`. - **Enable Advanced Voice Typing**: Unlocks the *Rambler* dictation engine in Voice typing settings. - **In-App Updates**: Built-in OTA updater to check for new releases, view changelogs, and download & install updates directly from GitHub. - **Rounded Keys**: Enable Google's Material 3 Expressive Belka pill-shaped keycaps. - **Multilingual Support**: Fully localized in 20+ languages matching your device's system locale. - **Toolbar Restart Button (`↻`)**: Optional one-tap process reload utility in the toolbar if you ever want to force a refresh, though all settings and toggles apply automatically in real time without restarts. - **Cleaned Preferences**: Promotional bloatware ("Rate Gboard" and "Help & feedback") has been completely removed. - **Custom Attribution**: Dedicated credit footer (*Akshay Kadam*). --- ## Installation Guide ### Option A: Direct Download on Your Phone (Easiest) 1. Download [**PixelBoard Stable APK (v1.3.6, 122 MB)**](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/releases/download/1.3.6/PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk) (or view the [**v1.3.6 Release Page**](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/releases/tag/1.3.6)). 2. Tap the downloaded `.apk` in your notification drawer or Downloads folder. 3. If prompted, toggle **"Allow from this source"** and tap **Install**. 4. Enable PixelBoard in **Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard**. ### Option B: Sideload via ADB (For Developers) Connect your Android phone via USB with USB Debugging enabled: ```bash adb install -r PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk adb shell am force-stop com.akshaykadam.pixelboard ``` *(If building from source locally, use `adb install -r output/PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk`)* ### Option C: Patch via Morphe Manager (On-Device Patcher) You can patch your stock Gboard APK directly on your phone using **Morphe Manager**: 1. Install **Morphe Manager** on your Android device. 2. Get the two required files: - **Patch Bundle**: [**PixelBoard.mpp**](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/raw/main/patches/PixelBoard.mpp) (or versioned [**patches-1.3.6.mpp**](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/releases/download/1.3.6/patches-1.3.6.mpp)) - **Stock Base APK**: Download the official base bundle from [**APKMirror (Gboard v18.6.3.100 Release)**](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/google-inc/gboard/gboard-the-google-keyboard-18-6-3-1002251336-release/). 3. In Morphe Manager, select **Storage**, choose the stock Gboard APK, and load `PixelBoard.mpp` as the patch source. 4. Tap **Patch** and then **Install**! > [!IMPORTANT] > **Strict Version Requirement**: The patch bundle **only works on Gboard version 18.6.3.100** (`18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a`). It does **not** work on older versions (such as Gboard 18.5 or earlier) because internal flag evaluation classes (`Lodf.g`), text input dispatchers, and resource IDs changed between versions. Patching older versions will cause hooks to miss and mods to not engage. If you do not want to patch manually, install the pre-built [**Signed APK (Option A)**](#option-a-direct-download-on-your-phone-easiest) directly. > [!TIP] > You can also add PixelBoard as a custom auto-updating patch source in Morphe Manager by adding: > ```text > https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/main/patches-bundle.json > ``` --- ## 📁 Project Structure ```text GBoardMod/ ├── README.md # Project documentation & direct download links ├── build.sh # 1-click automated build & patching script (100% offline) ├── options.json # Patch configuration profile ├── patches/ │ ├── PixelBoard.mpp # Pre-bundled offline patch pack (~1.6 MB) │ └── patches-bundle.json # Morphe Manager repository metadata ├── input/ │ └── gboard.apk # Base stock Gboard APK (v18.6.3.100 Release, ~122 MB) ├── output/ │ ├── PixelBoard.apk # Compiled APK (local build output / hosted on GitHub Releases) │ └── patching-result.json # Patch verification report ├── tools/ │ ├── patcher.jar # Standalone patch compiler CLI (Java 21) │ └── patcher-data/ # Signing keystore & local storage ├── LICENSE # GNU General Public License v3.0 └── pixelboard-patches/ # PixelBoard patch source repository (Kotlin/Smali) ├── gradle/ ├── patches/ # Patch definitions & Kotlin bytecode modifications └── extensions/ # Extension APK bytecode & runtime hooks ``` --- ## Compatibility Matrix | Property | Requirement | | :--- | :--- | | **Target Package** | `com.google.android.inputmethod.latin` | | **Required Base Version** | `18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a` (**v18.6.3.100** only) | | **Unsupported Versions** | Gboard `18.5.x` and older versions are **not supported** by this patch bundle | | **Architecture** | `arm64-v8a` | | **Android Version** | Android 10 (API 29) through Android 17 (Tested on Pixel 8 Pro) | | **Root Required** | **No** (Standalone side-by-side coexistence) | > [!CAUTION] > **Gboard Version Dependency**: The patch bundle is engineered specifically for **Gboard v18.6.3.100**. Patching Gboard 18.5 or older will cause flag evaluation hooks (`Lodf.g`) and resource bindings to miss, leaving all mods inactive. Always ensure you are patching stock Gboard `18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a` or directly download the pre-patched, ready-to-use [**PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk**](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/releases/download/1.3.6/PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk). > [!NOTE] > **Google Pixel Device Support**: Advanced on-device inference (**Private AICore / Astrea**) is available **only on Google Pixel devices**. Core **Rambler Natural Voice Typing**, **AI Writing Assistant**, proofreading, and tone rewrite work across all Android devices. --- ## Developer & Maintainer **Akshay Kadam** - GitHub: [@Akshayykadam](https://github.com/Akshayykadam) -
